rows.en: Oh, you're finally awake.

\p-chan!
...Did I... fall asleep, by any chance...?
Yeah, well... you were out like a light...

No, no, the lunch was delicious,
and I don't mind at all...
Well, then it can't be helped.
rows.notes: Female; she got up at 4 a.m. to make the lunch.

rows.en:
No, no, I don't mind at all.
Besides, this lunch was supposed to be
your apology for last time in the first place...
rows.notes: Female; answers 'I'll properly make it up to you next time'.

rows.en:
(Maybe Yuu's more of an airhead
than I thought?)
(I'm meeting Akimizu at the park again today.)
(But somehow... Eh, never mind...)
rows.notes: x2, player, both genders; a vague bad feeling, then shrugged off.

rows.en: Oh, right! Then, here's the lunch!
rows.notes: x2, Akimizu; after the player says he/she already knows why she is late.

rows.en:
I've been waiting for this!
Thanks for the food!
rows.notes: x2, player, both genders (itadakimasu, as c06196).

rows.en: (Well, Akimizu never means any harm...)
(I'm meeting Yuu at the park again today.)
(Yuu never means any harm, after all...)

(Akimizu told me, "It's not an apology or anything,
but only if you'd like to..."
so I asked her to hang out, but...)
(If she went out of her way to say that...)
Oh, Akimizu, you're early today.

I made sure not to run into anybody today,
so no problem!
rows.notes: x2, Akimizu; last time favors from everyone she met made her late.

rows.en: Well, well...

Today is my apology for last time...
No, wait, it isn't! Um, what is it, then...

Well, one way or another, it's my treat,
so order anything you like!
"One way or another"...?

It's fine! Today is, um, well...
It was payday at my part-time job!

Well, if you insist, I'll take you up on it...
I'll have this most expensive steak...

What?!
This place has something that expensive
on the menu?!
Nah, I'm joking, just joking.

Geez! You scared me~
I totally thought you were serious!

Okay, for real this time:
a coffee and the pineapple cake.
Hmm... Then I guess I'll just have coffee.
Mmm...
Akimizu?
Ahh, but after yesterday...
rows.notes: x2, Akimizu, muttering to herself; the Japanese keeps what happened yesterday vague (are).

rows.en: Akimizu? Akimizu-san? Akimizu-dono?
But, well, if I just try hard starting tomorrow...
Whoa! Yes? What, what?

What's wrong? You suddenly seemed
lost in thought...
Oh, it's nothing, nothing at all!
You seemed to be staring at my pineapple cake...
Huh?! Really? Geez, what's wrong with me...

Did you want some, by any chance?
The pineapple cake?

Um, well, uh...
I did, but right now I'm on a die...
rows.notes: x2, Akimizu; cut off mid-word (diet), kept cut.

rows.en: Oh, no, it's nothing. Don't worry about it.
Um... Do you want some of this?
Um, oh, okay... Then just one bite...
Here you go, then.
Thanks! Here I go~
...Mmmmmm...
Hm, what's wrong, Akimizu?
Mmm, so goooood!
Akimizu-san?

Um, well... I've been a little worried
about my weight lately, you see.

I've been cutting back on sweets for sooo long,
but the truth is, I love sweets...

Oh, so that's it.
That's why you were so torn.
Huh? Oh, yeah.

But you don't need to worry that much.
From what I can see, you've got a nice figure.
No, really, really.

Oh, stop... Ummm...
...Thank you...

Well, don't worry about it too much.
A treat once in a while is fine, isn't it?

Yeah, holding back just makes it harder,
after all. Maybe you're right.

Yeah, I'll start trying tomorrow...
I'm ordering a pineapple cake too!
Huh...
Yep, starting tomorrow, starting tomorrow!
Akimizu...
rows.notes: x3, male player (exasperated / gentle; used in several scenes).

rows.en: (Akimizu really does love sweets, huh...)

(Yuu told me, "It's not an apology or anything,
but only if you'd like to..."
so I asked her to hang out, but...)
Oh, Yuu, you're early today.

Well, if you insist, I'll gladly accept...
I'll have this most expensive steak...
Nah, I'm kidding, just kidding.
Yuu?
Yuu? Yuu-san? Akimizu-dono?
You seemed to be staring at my pineapple cake...
Hm, what's wrong, Yuu?
Yuu-san?

Oh, so that's it.
That's why you were so torn.

But you don't need to worry that much.
You've got a really great figure, Yuu.

I mean, you've got curves in all the right places.
I'm jealous.

Well, don't worry about it too much.
A treat once in a while is fine, right?
Yuu...
(Yuu really does love sweets, huh...)

(I'm supposed to go to "Silver Moon" with
Akimizu again today, but...)
rows.notes: Male, frd_yuu_003 second visit; the row cut after 'yotei' is the Japanese line break.
